raw:
Between one page and the next, you consider a possible title for a future short story: *The Red Umbrella*.

Nothing follows it. There is no story yet, and you make no note of the words. The title remains private, unspoken and unwritten.

You return to your reading.

Below, an office chair scrapes back. A drawer closes, keys turn, and Nell’s footsteps cross the foyer. The side door shuts firmly behind her. After that, the Picture House settles into its nighttime sounds: pipes cooling in the walls, an occasional shift of timber, and the wind moving along Harbour Street.

You turn another page beneath the desk lamp.
